payload.core_mechanism_summary: 2D DP on grid: for each cell and step count t, compute min cost path of length t using recurrence with neighbor costs, then closed walk cost = 2 * DP[s/2].
payload.rationale: Uses iterative DP over grid cells and half-steps with state defined by (i,j) and t. Recurrence on minimum neighbor edge costs matches dp_2d_state pattern.
